question.worked_solution:
Solving $x-2v=0$ for $x,$ we get $x=2v.$ Therefore, any vector from $\text{Ker}(T)$ can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}2v \\ y \\ z \\ 0 \\ v\end{aligned}]=y{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{1}}+z{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{2}}+v{{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{3}}.\end{aligned}
$$

This means that $\text{Ker}(T)=\text{Span}\{{v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3}\}.$ Therefore, $\text{nullity}(T)=3.$ 

Finally, according the rank-nullity theorem, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{rank}(T) & =5-\text{nullity}(T) \\  & =5-3 \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
